column1: # search-v2 — the search-quality benchmark, second version (PLAN §7.3 D, §7.4 I3, §8).
# Freeze discipline (§8), same as v1: this file is never edited to make a run pass. It
# contains every search-v1 line VERBATIM — copied, not re-judged, so the two versions stay
# comparable — plus new demonstration queries for the three indexing gaps the previous
# batch closed, which v1 could not contain because at its freeze date they were misses:
#   attributes  — attribute names and attribute-level ai_desc joined the haystack
#   nested      — operation-level ai_desc prose joined the haystack
#   compound    — words and identifier compounds became interchangeable
#                 (round trip ↔ roundtrip, blob sum ↔ blob_sum, track manager ↔ TrackManager)
# The new lines are class `exact` because the lexical index of TODAY must hit them; their
# rationale names the gap they demonstrate. v1 remains the frozen baseline and must keep
# passing unchanged; this file is what the embedding batch and its successors are judged
# against going forward. New or corrected cases after this freeze go to search-v3.tsv.
# Format: query <TAB> expected repository ids (comma-separated, may be empty) <TAB> class <TAB> rationale
# Classes: exact | synonym | negative | injection — definitions verbatim in search-v1.tsv's header.
# Baseline measured 2026-08-13 over corpus/golden/*.idl + spikes/echo.idl through
# Bridge::search (the MCP tool's own code path), lexical, no vector index:
# The synonym 0/10 is still the recorded headroom for the embedding path, not a defect.
